content.comment_body: Hello, I am new to [product_name], and I have a simple question. When I select the "Writable" option in the output settings within [product_name] software, it allows the output to be operated from the web interface. However, if I also try to control that same output using a digital input in [product_name] programming tool, it is no longer operable via the web page. Is there a way for a digital output to be controlled simultaneously by both a digital input and from the web page?

This is a common issue for beginners. You cannot operate an output independently using two parallel static signals. You need to create dynamic signals using both static sources. There is an example attached.
Thank you, this resolved my issue.

analysis.insight_summary: The user was unsure why enabling output control via the web interface in [product_name] web tool prevented simultaneous control by a physical digital input through [product_name] programming software. The main confusion was that output sources are mutually exclusive by default, which was not obvious to a newcomer seeking combined control options.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to control a single digital output both from the web interface and a physical digital input, expecting both sources to function together smoothly.
